text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Entering the VR Umalator, I spotted Byerley Turk with an unusually serious expression.
When I asked what was going on...

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
I am about to head into the mountains for secluded training.
I intend to forge myself through survival.
choice_data_list: Then what about the two behind you...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yay, camping time! Mountain stream fishing
and making curry, right? I can't wait~♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Mountains is pure nature fest vibe, yeah?
Hype levels THROUGH THE ROOF FOOOO♪

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
When I mentioned spending a night in the mountains, they asked to tag along.
To willingly volunteer for a harsh regimen shows promising grit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Worried about the two who clearly misunderstood the situation,
I decided to follow Byerley Turk.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Judging by the sun's angle, it has been about three hours...
Let us take a break. Do not neglect hydration in reality.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Uhahaha~☆ Legally dying rn, big sadge~~!
My eyes~~ my eyes are spinning round and round whoopee~~☆

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...WE GOT TRICKED!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Why are we so deep in the mountains!?
Where's the campsite? Isn't there a tent or something—!?

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: We have no need for such fragile luxuries. ...You volunteered for this, so surely you have no intention of running away?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...! Who's gonna run away!
I am the invincible Teio-sama!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right on~☆ We're totally down to be mountain gals!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Making fire is essential in survival.
By striking stone shaped for sparking against collected pinecones as kindling—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real!? Instant fire in seconds!?
Insane!! Can I try it too!?

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead. Knowledge makes a person strong.
Learn so that you can survive in any environment.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Once this is done, we shall set up camp.
It will be too late after the sun goes down. Nocturnal beasts pose the greatest threat.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
In particular, if you encounter a bear, never show your back to it.
Playing dead is completely useless.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ......A bear?
choice_data_list: W-We will keep that firmly in mind...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Though I said that, I was far too worried to fall asleep.
With no other choice, I stepped out of my sleeping quarters—

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: Good grief... You are awake too?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that bears might show up would keep anyone up!
And then—!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And then... who knew you were actually watching over us?
Just so no wild animals would attack us.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Pulling an all-nighter for that is god-tier, right!?
Beyond supreme, it's suuuper supreme!!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Pay it no mind. If you do not know, you merely need to learn.
...That is how everyone grows stronger.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Long ago, the Umamusume known as Byerley Turk also learned vital lessons from someone special.
—Such records still remain.
I brought back food. Securing nutrients is the golden rule of survival. Hammer into your head which creatures provide efficient nourishment.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: Ugh...! Forgive me, it is because of my powerlessness...!

Do not apologize.
Being weak is by no means a sin.

Survive, and become stronger than anyone else.
...I am counting on you, my partner.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
An irreplaceable existence who elevated oneself—
So it is recorded.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Remember this: no one can grow alone.
It is irreplaceable bonds that make one strong.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: Comrades, rivals, partners—you girls must have special figures like that as well.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: ...Never forget that fiery passion.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow we descend the mountain at sunrise.
Get some rest now and conserve your stamina.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Hey, hey, just for a little bit, chat with us some more!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: There's this burning fire in my chest right now, and I just can't fall asleep!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: ...Only for a little while.
